collection.title: Historical computer collection
collection.intro: Explore computers by manufacturer and family, review their preservation status, and create a historically accurate machine.
collection.variants.olivetti-m6-5x0.summ: Three factory configurations with Micro Channel, ATI graphics and SCSI.
collection.variants.olivetti-m6-5x0.upgr: The M6-520 has a soldered i486SX and accepts a 25 MHz i487SX. The guide also lists i486DX2 and Pentium OverDrive P24T. On the M6-540 and M6-560, the upgrade replaces the processor fitted in the socket.
collection.variants.olivetti-m6-5x0.firm: Reply R1.47.36 preserved. The donor machine model and board are still to be identified.
collection.variants.olivetti-m6-7x0.summ: Three ISA/PCI configurations, each in a Tin or Slim case. The S suffix identifies the Slim case, which has fewer expansion slots.
collection.variants.olivetti-m6-7x0.upgr: The guide lists OverDrive P24D, P24T and P24CT in the cache settings for the BA2123 and BA2136 boards.
collection.variants.olivetti-m4-4xx-entr: Entry platform with CL-GD5424 graphics. Models with the S suffix use the compact case.
collection.variants.olivetti-m4-4xx-enha: Enhanced platform with CL-GD5428 graphics and local-bus IDE. Models with the S suffix use the compact case.
collection.variants.olivetti-pcs42p-entr: Entry platform with CL-GD5424 graphics. The E suffix identifies the larger case.
collection.variants.olivetti-pcs42p-enha: Enhanced platform with CL-GD5428 graphics and local-bus IDE. The E suffix identifies the larger case.
collection.variants.olivetti-modulo-l.su: Three Pentium configurations on the BA2292 LPX board.
collection.variants.olivetti-pcs40-range: The SX/25 shipped in a Slim case with five ISA slots. The other four models were minitowers with eight slots.
collection.variants.olivetti-m6-4x0.summ: Four factory ISA configurations. The guide distinguishes BA2000, BA2001 and BA2002 boards, as well as BA2003 and BA2004 boards supplied without a CPU.
collection.variants.olivetti-m4-5x4.summ: Three 486 configurations in two case formats. The guide distinguishes boards with and without integrated Ethernet.
collection.variants.olivetti-m24-new.sum: Three Pentium configurations derived from the M4-Pxx and PCS 51xx line.
collection.variants.olivetti-m4-4x-micro: Two factory 486 configurations in the MicroTower case with a T.1 board.
The M4-40 accepts a 25 MHz i487SX or a 50 MHz i486DX2. The M4-46 shipped with a 50 MHz i486DX2.
Five factory 486 configurations in the M305 case. The guide distinguishes T.1 and T.1.5 boards.
The guide lists i487SX for M4-60 and M4-62, and i486DX2 for M4-60, M4-62 and M4-64. Pentium OverDrive P24T is listed for T.1.5 revisions.
The library holds an R2.03/A4BF dump attributed to the M4-65. Its relationship to the PD2C reference in the guide remains to be checked.
Two i486DX2 configurations with a CPU card on a 32-bit EISA board.
The guide documents the OverDrive P24T as a replacement for the factory processor in both models.
The guide lists BIOS 1.2 rev. 2.3 for both models.
